description: List available implementation skills (IDs, names, descriptions, tags) from the VibeKit skills registry. Discover skills here before fetching one with vibekit_get_skill.
name: vibekit_list_skills

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Array of available skills, optionally filtered by tag, each with id, name, and tags.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit List Skills
